name: Watermelon Basil Margarita
desc: Watermelon juice and gently muddled basil shaken with blanco tequila, lime and Cointreau.

source.title: Watermelon & Basil Margarita
source.evidence: Same tequila, lime, 2 oz watermelon juice, basil and syrup, shaken and served in a salt-rimmed glass; VinePair uses a basil syrup instead of muddled leaves and no Cointreau.

ingredients.raw: 1 pinch flaky salt or Tajin, for the rim
4 fresh basil leaves, plus 1 sprig for garnish
2 oz watermelon juice (from about 1/2 cup cubed seedless watermelon)
ingredients.note: from about 1/2 cup cubed seedless watermelon

steps: Make the watermelon juice: blend the cubed watermelon until smooth and pour it through a fine mesh strainer, pressing lightly.
Rim the glass: run the lime wedge around the rim of a rocks glass and dip it in the flaky salt or Tajin. Fill with fresh ice and set aside.
Muddle the basil: add the 4 basil leaves to a shaker and press gently, only enough to release the oils. Shredding them turns the drink bitter.
Build and shake: add the tequila, watermelon juice, lime juice, Cointreau and simple syrup. Fill with ice and shake hard until well chilled, about 15 seconds.
Double strain (through the shaker strainer and a fine mesh strainer) over the fresh ice in your prepared glass. Garnish with the basil sprig.
tips: The Watermelon Board version skips the juicing step and muddles 6 watermelon cubes with 6 basil leaves right in the shaker.
